_comment: Consumers are DISCOVERED, not listed here. scripts/usage-manifest.mjs walks
the parent of this checkout (the workspace root) to depth 3 and takes every
package.json declaring one of `specifiers` in a dependency map.
This file used to carry `repos`: a map of name -> ABSOLUTE PATH, all of them
under one developer's home directory. On every other machine each path
resolved 'missing' and the pre-push gate returned without checking anything.
The list had also drifted from reality — it omitted three real consumers,
one of them the only SelectableTable caller in existence.
